_four_name_verdicts_2026-08-18: FLFL, RTNINDIA, TATASTLBSL, UNIVCABLES - all NO_CONSOLIDATED_QUARTERLY, all four floors confirmed by a second filer-sourced reader (BSE cover-letter text + local XBRL NatureOfReportStandaloneConsolidated). FLFL and UNIVCABLES are textbook annual-consolidation cases: their annual filings scope consolidated to the YEAR while only standalone gets a QUARTER (UNIVCABLES even files them ten days apart). TATASTLBSL states it outright on 2019-04-17: standalone "for the quarter", standalone AND consolidated "for the financial year". RTNINDIA filed as RattanIndia Infrastructure (NSE RTNINFRA) in that era - same scrip code, later renamed - and every pre-floor cover letter says "standalone". In all four the first consolidated quarterly lands EXACTLY on the existing NSE floor; no floor moved. MoneyControl was unreachable this pass, so its specific pre-floor values remain undecoded - but no filing exists that could produce its FLFL 2016 or TATASTLBSL 2009 claims.
